title: 第十四章 北山军区第十五章 战将级
lines: 第十四章北山军区
“队长，不对啊，我们好几个队友都失去了消息，而且也没有回来回复，太反常了。”说话的是一名年轻的士兵。
蔡鹏飞眉头一皱，他们红队一下子又损失了好几名队友，却没有一点消息回来，确实太奇怪了。
“蔡队，李自力和张远发找到了，不过他们都昏迷了。”
正在蔡鹏飞疑惑的时候，又有士兵传来了消息，他连忙说道：“弄醒他们！”
特种兵都学过急救，很快就把李自力和张远发弄清醒了。
“到底怎么回事，快说！”蔡鹏飞急忙问道。
“我们看到了对方的一个单兵，正想把他拿下，哪里知道对方的身手太好了，一瞬间就把我们打晕了。”
“难道是王聪？”蔡鹏飞问道，也只有王聪才有这种实力吧。
“不是，王聪我们都见过，虽然没有看清对方的面貌，但可以确定不是王聪！”李自力说道。
不是王聪，还会有谁？
蔡鹏飞皱眉，难道蓝队里面还有这种高手？这样他们胜利的几率就渺茫了不少啊。
“走，我们去包夹此人，不能让他和蓝军汇合！”
蔡鹏飞果断的下了命令，不管对方是什么人，胆敢只身闯入他们红军的地盘，那就让他回不去了。
叶欢一路前行，路上遇到不少前来偷袭的士兵。
不过都被叶欢打晕了，顺手扔在了草丛里。
叶欢没有隐藏自己踪迹的意思，很快就被蔡鹏飞等人追到了。
足足有50多人，围成一个圈把叶欢包围了起来。
“兄弟，胆子很大啊，敢一个人闯入我们红军的地盘。有种，我还不知道，蓝军还有你这种高手。”
蔡鹏飞看到叶欢已经被包围在中间，看着叶欢说道，却没有注意到叶欢脚下的那只金色小狼。
“也别说我们人多欺负你，我给你一个机会，我给你个机会，我来和单挑，赢了，就放你走。”还没等叶欢反应，蔡鹏飞又继续说道。
他又自信，北山军区单挑没人是自己对手，即便是王聪亲自来，一对一他也有信心。
“我不是你们军队的人，我只是路过龙安森林，没兴趣和你切磋！”
叶欢直接说道，他也很无语，没想到自己闯入了军事禁区。
打昏一个又来一个，现在又来这么一群。
什么？不是北山军区的人！
蔡鹏飞不再犹豫，直接冲了上去，要将来历不明的这人制服。
他腿法凌厉，一记横扫提向叶欢，叶欢同样是一脚踢出。
两腿相交。
蔡鹏飞惨叫一声，他感觉自己的右腿像是踢到钢筋铁棍一般，痛得他大叫出来。
叶欢又是一脚踢出，揣在了蔡鹏飞胸口，蔡鹏飞直接倒飞出去。
刚才那一脚他留手了，不然那一脚就可以让对方的腿直接废了。
他们毕竟是军人，叶欢不知道这里到底有多少军队，要是都带着真枪实弹来，叶欢还真跑不出去。
除非到时候刺激体内的嗜血丹，化身嗜血杀神。
content_en:
Chapter 14 Beishan Military Region
"Captain, that's not right. Several of our teammates have lost their messages and haven't come back to reply. It's so abnormal." The person who spoke was a young soldier.
Cai Pengfei frowned. The red team lost several teammates all of a sudden, but no news came back. It was really strange.
"Captain Cai, Li Zili and Zhang Yuanfa were found, but they are all unconscious."
Just when Cai Pengfei was confused, another soldier came with news. He quickly said: "Wake them up!"
The special forces had all learned first aid and quickly woke up Li Zili and Zhang Yuanfa.
"What's going on? Tell me quickly!" Cai Pengfei asked hurriedly.
"We saw an individual soldier of the other side and were about to capture him. Little did we know that the other side was so skilled that he knocked us unconscious in an instant."
"Is it Wang Cong?" Cai Pengfei asked. Only Wang Cong has this kind of strength.
"No, we have all met Wang Cong. Although we didn't see the other person's face clearly, we can be sure it's not Wang Cong!" Li Zili said.
If not Wang Cong, who else could it be?
Cai Pengfei frowned, is there such a master in the blue team? In this way, their chances of victory are much slimmer.
"Let's go, let's double-team this guy. We can't let him join the Blue Army!"
Cai Pengfei gave the order decisively. No matter who the other party was, if he dared to break into their Red Army's territory alone, he would not be able to go back.
Ye Huan walked along the way and encountered many soldiers who came to attack him.
However, they were all knocked unconscious by Ye Huan and thrown into the grass.
Ye Huan had no intention of hiding his traces, and was soon chased by Cai Pengfei and others.
More than 50 people formed a circle and surrounded Ye Huan.
"Brother, you are very brave. You dare to break into the territory of our Red Army alone. If you have the guts, I didn't know that there are experts like you in the Blue Army."
Cai Pengfei saw that Ye Huan was surrounded, looked at Ye Huan and said, but did not notice the little golden wolf at Ye Huan's feet.
"Don't say that there are too many of us to bully you. I'll give you a chance. I'll challenge you to a one-on-one challenge. If you win, I'll let you go." Before Ye Huan could react, Cai Pengfei continued.
He is also confident that no one in the Beishan Military Region can be his opponent. Even if Wang Cong comes in person, he is confident in one-on-one combat.
"I'm not from your army. I'm just passing through Long'an Forest and have no interest in competing with you!"
Ye Huan said directly. He was also speechless. He didn't expect that he had broken into a military restricted area.
After knocking one out, another one came, and now this group came again.
What? Not from the Beishan Military Region!
Cai Pengfei no longer hesitated and rushed forward to subdue the man of unknown origin.
With his sharp kicks, he lifted Ye Huan with a sweeping sweep, and Ye Huan also kicked him out.
The legs meet.
"Ah!"
Cai Pengfei screamed. He felt as if his right leg had been kicked by a steel rod, and he screamed in pain.
Ye Huan kicked out again and hit Cai Pengfei in the chest. Cai Pengfei flew backwards.
He held back on the kick just now, otherwise the kick would have completely destroyed the opponent's legs.
After all, they are soldiers. Ye Huan doesn't know how many troops there are here. If they all come with real guns and live ammunition, Ye Huan really won't be able to escape.
Unless the time comes to stimulate the bloodthirsty pill in the body and transform into a bloodthirsty killing god.
